hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in /Users/jpro/code/picnivo/frontend/*) npx prettier --write "$f" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in /Users/jpro/code/picnivo/backend/*.cs) cd /Users/jpro/code/picnivo/backend && dotnet csharpier format "$f" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in /Users/jpro/code/picnivo/frontend/*.ts|/Users/jpro/code/picnivo/frontend/*.tsx) cd /Users/jpro/code/picnivo/frontend && out=$(pnpm exec eslint --fix --quiet "$f" 2>&1); code=$?; if [ $code -ne 0 ]; then echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; fi ;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in /Users/jpro/code/picnivo/frontend/*.ts|/Users/jpro/code/picnivo/frontend/*.tsx) cd /Users/jpro/code/picnivo/frontend && out=$(pnpm exec tsc --noEmit 2>&1); code=$?; if [ $code -ne 0 ]; then echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; fi ;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in /Users/jpro/code/picnivo/frontend/src/features/events/get-event-by-token/*.ts|/Users/jpro/code/picnivo/frontend/src/features/events/get-event-by-token/*.tsx|/Users/jpro/code/picnivo/frontend/src/features/events/set-attendance/*.ts|/Users/jpro/code/picnivo/frontend/src/features/events/set-attendance/*.tsx) cd /Users/jpro/code/picnivo/frontend && out=$(pnpm exec vitest related "$f" --run 2>&1); code=$?; if [ $code -ne 0 ]; then echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; fi ;; esac; }
